description: Process specific Gmail emails as receipts when the user supplies Gmail message IDs; to find receipts use scan_gmail. No server preview: on call each email is converted to PDF, extracted by AI and added to the user's expense spreadsheet. Max 25 emails per request. Requires Gmail connected in ExpenseBot.

accountEmail.description: Optional: which Gmail account to use (for users with multiple linked accounts)

emailIds.description: Gmail message IDs to process as receipts

name: process_gmail_receipts
